messages:
maria-chen: Heads up — nightly evals show a quality regression for redwood/sbert-2.1-quant-int8 vs 2.1-fp16 on the semantic-sim suite. avg cosine down ~3.4%, r@1 drop too. Anyone seeing this?

eval-runner-bot: nightly job failed for some shards: https://ci.internal/runs/482 — runner timeout + partial reports produced.

eli: I pulled the failing logs. There's an exception during metric postprocessing. Snippet:```
2026-03-20T02:14:12Z MetricAggregator: computing r_precision
2026-03-20T02:14:12Z ZeroDivisionError: denominator==0 in r_precision
2026-03-20T02:14:12Z stack: evals/metrics/r_precision.py:42
```

sasha: we changed epsilon handling last week in PR #589 to 1e-9 to avoid div-by-zero, but quantized models produce more empty candidate lists in some negative-sampling configs. Could be related.

jun: I reproduced locally with a minimized harness. It only fails when using batched_evaluator v0.7.2. Command I used:```
python -m evals.runner --model redwood/sbert:2.1-quant-int8 --suite semantic-sim --seed 42 --revision HEAD~5
```
The non-batched path (v0.7.1) is fine.

maria-chen: Can someone bisect the eval harness/runner? If it's a runner bug we need revert or hotfix — this blocks the quant release. :exclamation:

eli: I'll bisect runner commits now. If it points to a single commit we can cherry-pick a fix to the release branch. ETA ~30m.

ci-bot: Rerun triggered: https://ci.internal/runs/482/try-01 (nightly-evals, pinned image try).

eli: Bisect complete — culprit is commit 9c2fb3a (eval-runner): "optimize batch padding for quant models". It changed batching to drop zero-length candidate lists which later leads to zero denominator in r_precision.

sasha: That commit was intended to reduce memory for quant workloads. Quick fix is to guard the metric: if candidate_count==0 then precision=0 (or skip) and log. I'll open PR for that guard.

jun: Workaround for release: pin batched_evaluator to v0.7.1 in CI images and rerun full nightly. If we do that we can unblock the release while sasha's PR lands.

maria-chen: Decision: pin CI to v0.7.1 (ops to patch) and merge sasha's guard PR to main. Which is faster to get nightly green? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sasha: I'll open the PR for the guard check now (small change + unit test).

ops-oncall: Pinned nightly-eval image to batched_evaluator v0.7.1 at 1779001530. Rerun scheduled.

maria-chen: Thanks team. Once nightly passes we'll mark the quant release unblocked and land the hotfix for the release branch. Please add the bisect notes to the release blockers doc. :thumbsup:

eli: also adding a note to the eval-runner changelog to avoid similar silent failures (missing candidate lists) in future.

maria-chen: tagging this resolved for now — follow-up: backport guard to v2.1 release branch and add a regression test that runs quantized sample with negative sampling edge cases.
